title: A spin crossover in a specified energy model
promptMarkdown: An octahedral d⁶ ion has Δₒ=150 kJ mol⁻¹ and pairing cost P=180 kJ mol⁻¹ per pair. Draw high- and low-spin occupancies, count unpaired electrons and pairs, and calculate their CFSE and total CFSE+pairing energy. Repeat the energy comparison for Δₒ=220 with the same P. Derive the crossover condition and give spin-only moments. Explain what the simple model omits.
hintLadder: First count pairs explicitly instead of using the unpaired count as the pairing term.
Derive the symbolic energy difference before inserting numbers.
A barycentre energy is not the energy of separated metal and ligands.

criteria.criterion: Correctly fills orbitals and counts pairs/spins
